title: One-step equations
goal: I can solve one-step equations using inverse operations.
teach: Keep the balance level: do the same to both sides. Use the inverse operation to get the unknown on its own: subtract to undo +, add to undo −, divide to undo ×, multiply to undo ÷.

steps: 4x means 4 × x. Undo × 4 by dividing both sides by 4.

watch: Do the same to both sides. To solve x − 8 = 20, add 8 (do not subtract 8).

qs.steps:
1. Rule (balance method): do the same to both sides. Undo each operation with its inverse (− undoes +, ÷ undoes ×): first undo + or −, then undo × or ÷.
2. y − 7 = 12
3. Add 7: y = 12 + 7
4. y = 19
